title: structure/AGENTS: legacy .xls needs SheetJS xlsx, not exceljs
description: AGENTS.md names exceljs as THE xlsx package; it cannot read BIFF8 .xls (OLE2). Name SheetJS xlsx for legacy .xls + note ESM gotcha: import XLSX from 'xlsx' (default), not import * as XLSX (namespace has no readFile). From docs/structure-benchmark.md #2.

title: structure: Excel/spreadsheet dates are timezone-naive — never parse via Date
description: Reading Excel serials as JS Date (SheetJS cellDates:true) shifts every date by the runner's UTC offset; turned 1987-05-20 into 1987-05-19 in the oil-prices build. Skill must mandate: raw serials -> XLSX.SSF.parse_date_code (offset-free) -> spot-check first date vs source's documented start. Add to scripts/wrangling-idioms.mjs with a test. From docs/structure-benchmark.md #1.

title: structure: promote toCsv() + num(raw,sentinels) into wrangling-idioms.mjs
description: Both helpers now copy-pasted across co2-ppm, project-drawdown, oil-prices builds. Move into scripts/wrangling-idioms.mjs (the tested-idiom module) and have structure import rather than inline. From docs/structure-benchmark.md #8.
